name: danish-tool-calling-benchmark
description:
Danish Tool Calling Benchmark
	

This dataset was made to benchmark projects for BADM500 - bachelor projects
Contains tests for following tool calls types

get_weather: Get the current weather for a given location.
correct_grammar: Correct the given sentence.
generate_image: Generate an image from a given description.
speech_synthesis: Generate speech based on a given text input.
search_web: Search the web for information relevant to the given prompt.
reputation: An educational benchmark created for bachelor projects (BADM500) with limited adoption beyond the course and related student projects.
